PanelDescription.SourceString: 滴滴！塔吉多来信了，它似乎需要一些帮助……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Ding! You've received mail from Taygedo. Looks like he needs some help…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 塔吉多等人正在说悄悄话，他们似乎遇到了一些麻烦……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Taygedo is whispering to others. Seems like they're in trouble…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 为了约会，塔吉多决定拿出私房钱购买一套帅气的服装……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: For the upcoming date, Taygedo has decided to dip into his secret savings to buy some stylish clothes…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 西装展柜的衣服一下子吸引了塔吉多的注意力……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The suits in the display case immediately caught Taygedo's attention…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （快到了！新衣服！新衣服！）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (We're almost there! New clothes! New clothes!)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （要做西装塔吉多！）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Taygedo! Suiting up!)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 眼前的衣服似乎让塔吉多很满意…
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: These clothes seem to be exactly what Taygedo was looking for…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 眼前的衣服似乎让塔吉多很满意…
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: These clothes seem to be exactly what Taygedo was looking for…

Description.SourceString: 与周围的<blue>店员</>了解情况

PanelDescription.SourceString: 店内都是人类款式的衣服，塔吉多能穿的尺码，似乎只有店员才会知道……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The store only carries human-sized clothing. Only the staff would know which sizes might fit Taygedo…

Description.SourceString: 与<blue>试衣间</>的<blue>塔吉多</>交谈

PanelDescription.SourceString: 塔吉多在试衣间的声音吸引了周围店员的注意，为了避免误会，还是过去看看情况吧……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The noises coming from Taygedo in the fitting room have caught the staff's attention. Better check what's going on before there's any misunderstanding…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 总算是准备好了塔吉多的衣服，他这会正在店外等你汇合……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Finally got Taygedo's clothes sorted out. He's waiting to meet you outside the store…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （西装塔吉多，回头率满分！）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Taygedo in suit, turning heads left and right!)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 获得西服的塔吉多非常得意，他正在炫耀自己的衣服……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Taygedo is quite proud of his new suit and can't help showing it off…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （礼物要承载塔吉多满满心意！）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (The gift must be bursting with Taygedo's feelings!)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 为了准备好重大约会，塔吉多还有一份礼物想要带给塔可小姐。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: To make his big date perfect, Taygedo wants to bring a gift for Miss Tako.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （塔吉多，选择困难！）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Taygedo can't decide!)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 如果感到无从下手，要不要先去其他店转一转？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: If you're feeling stuck, how about we take a stroll at other shops first?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 先挑选好漂亮的礼物箱、丝带、搭配用的花束，再配合它们来选择礼品，似乎也不失为一种妥当的方式。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: It might be a good approach to first choose a nice gift box, ribbon, and matching bouquet, then select the gift to go with them.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 惊喜匣子礼品店似乎有很多选择，帮助塔吉多挑选一下吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Surprise Box Gift Shop seems to have plenty of options. Let's help Taygedo pick something out.

BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (…A bouquet!)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （阿德勒先生，约会专家！）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Mr. Adler, the date whisperer!)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （花束好主意！塔吉多想买——大红色玫瑰！）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (A bouquet's perfect! Taygedo wants… red roses!)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 塔吉多想要花朵作为点缀，去花店看看吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Taygedo wants to add some flowers as a finishing touch. Let's check out the flower shop.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 红色玫瑰似乎很符合塔吉多的心意，买下！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The red roses seem perfect for what Taygedo had in mind. Let's buy them!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 红色玫瑰似乎很符合塔吉多的心意，买下！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The red roses seem perfect for what Taygedo had in mind. Let's buy them!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 店家的随心泥吸引了塔吉多的注意力，交谈中得知随心泥是DSD新推出的异象玩具，塔吉多想去潮玩店看看情况……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The store's Imaginadough caught Taygedo's attention. After learning it's a new Anomaly toy from DSD POP, Taygedo wants to check out the Pop Toys shop…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （塔吉多动手能力很强！）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Taygedo, crafty hands, DIY master!)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 如果是选择用素材自己制作手工礼物，的确要比购买现成的更有诚意。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: A handicraft is indeed more sincere and meaningful than buying something off the shelf.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 从另一个角度看，也算是预算内的实惠之选。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: And it's very friendly for Taygedo's fat secret stash.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 店家的随心泥吸引了塔吉多的注意力，交谈中得知随心泥是DSD新推出的异象玩具，塔吉多想去潮玩店看看情况……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The store's Imaginadough caught Taygedo's attention. After learning it's a new Anomaly toy from DSD POP, Taygedo wants to check out the Pop Toys shop…

Description.LocalizedString: Talk to the customer at <blue>DSD POP</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 与周围顾客打听下随心泥的事情……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Ask the customers around here about Imaginadough…

PanelDescription.SourceString: DSD引领潮流的新品玩具「随心泥」深得塔吉多的中意，为了他的恋爱计划，或许需要先详细理解一下随心泥的使用方法……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: DSD POP's trendy new toy Imaginadough has caught Taygedo's fancy. For his romance plan to succeed, perhaps we should first understand how to use Imaginadough in detail…

PanelDescription.SourceString: DSD引领潮流的新品玩具「随心泥」深得塔吉多的中意，为了他的恋爱计划，或许需要先详细理解一下随心泥的使用方法……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: DSD POP's trendy new toy Imaginadough has caught Taygedo's fancy. For his romance plan to succeed, perhaps we should first understand how to use Imaginadough in detail…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 不知道埃德嘉把约会计划制定得怎么样了……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: I wonder how Edgar's coming along with the date plan…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （塔吉多，最最期待！）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Taygedo can't wait!)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 负责制定约会计划的埃德嘉正在伊波恩等待你们的回归……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Edgar, who's in charge of planning the date, is waiting for your return at Eibon…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 埃德嘉被娜娜莉和早雾围住了？！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Edgar's been cornered by Nanally and Sakiri?!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 今天劳累了一天，需要好好休息一下了……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: It's been a long day. Time to get some well-deserved rest…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 休息一下，准备明天实施作战吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Let's take a break and get ready for tomorrow's operation.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 塔吉多的恋爱计划即将实行，大家都准备好了，正在伊波恩的门口等你……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Taygedo's romantic plan is about to begin. Everyone's ready and waiting for you at the Entrance of Eibon…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 众人为了塔吉多的恋爱出谋划策，与大家交谈一下，看看是否都准备妥当……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Everyone's been helping plan Taygedo's romantic endeavor. Let's talk to them and make sure everything's ready…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 你和塔吉多、阿德勒正在前往约会地点附近，准备与塔可汇合。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: You're heading to the date location with Taygedo and Adler to meet up with Tako.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 说起来最后……计划制定得怎么样了？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: By the way, how did the final plan turn out?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （第一精彩，胜券在握！）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (It's gonna be epic! Victory is in the bag!)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 你和塔吉多、阿德勒正在前往约会地点附近，准备与塔可汇合。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: You're heading to the date location with Taygedo and Adler to meet up with Tako.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （这里……登场是……）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (And next to make entrance is…)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （呜呜呜，娜、娜娜莉？）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Eep! N-Nanally?)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 娜娜莉他们已经去准备了，塔吉多不用太过紧张。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Nanally and the others have already gone to get ready. There's no need to be so nervous, Taygedo.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 只要大胆走上前即可，其余的交给我们就好。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: All you need to do is step forward confidently. We'll take care of the rest.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （塔吉多不紧张、不紧张……）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Taygedo's not nervous, not nervous at all…)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 塔可就在前面，快去与她汇合吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Tako is just up ahead. Let's go meet up with her.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 娜娜莉准备的精彩演出？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: A special performance prepared by Nanally?

QuestName.SourceString: 恋爱大片但是漏洞百出

PanelDescription.SourceString: 刚才的表演给塔吉多塑造了一个「高大」的第一印象，与塔可小姐交谈了解下她的想法吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: That performance has really helped Taygedo create a strong first impression. Let's talk to Tako and see what she thinks.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 塔吉多可以教教咱你拿手的游戏吗？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Hey Taygedo, can you teach me the games you're really good at?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （塔吉多最擅长那种——方块会从天上掉下来的游戏！）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Taygedo's best at that game where blocks fall from the sky!)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 你和塔吉多等人，正准备前往电玩城……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: You and Taygedo's group are getting ready to head to the Arcade…

Description.SourceString: 在<blue>电玩城</>门口对话<blue>塔吉多</>

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 喂……埋伏的位置需要临时变更。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Hey… We need to change the ambush position on short notice.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: ……嗯，对。尽快确认一下……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: …Yes, that's right. Confirm it as soon as possible…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （阿德勒先生在打电话吗？真不容易啊，不过埋伏是指……？）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Is Adler on the phone? His job seems tough… But what's this ambush about?)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 到达电玩城后，塔吉多似乎有话要说……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: After arriving at the Arcade, it seems Taygedo has something to say…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 之后要让塔吉多怎么补偿我好呢……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Now, how am I gonna have Taygedo make this up to me later…

Description.SourceString: 购买<blue>噗卡限定珍珠贝糖</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 塔吉多为博塔可小姐欢心夸下海口，只能拜托你去买一些糖果回来了。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Taygedo made quite a bold promise to impress Tako, so now he needs you to go buy some candies.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 阿德勒发来了新消息，是塔吉多发生了什么吗？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: There's a new message from Adler. Did something happen to Taygedo?

Description.SourceString: 前往<blue>电玩城娃娃机</>附近

PanelDescription.SourceString: 阿德勒发来了新消息，是塔吉多发生了什么吗？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: There's a new message from Adler. Did something happen to Taygedo?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 塔吉多好像遇到了什么问题，看上去需要一些帮助……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Looks like Taygedo's run into some trouble and needs help…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 想要抓娃娃的塔吉多，急需你的帮助。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Taygedo wants to try the claw machine and desperately needs your help.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 将塔吉多的恋爱计划推进至下一步吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Let's help move Taygedo's romantic plan to the next stage.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 将塔吉多的恋爱计划推进至下一步吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Let's help move Taygedo's romantic plan to the next stage.

Description.LocalizedString: Go to the <blue>intersection at White Parrot Street</>

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 鉴定师，我们从白鹦鹉街的路口过去吧。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Appraiser, let's go through the intersection at White Parrot Street.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: ……是还准备了什么东西吗？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: …Have you got something else planned?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 下一个目标是「白鹦鹉街」，那里似乎有些什么准备……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The next destination is White Parrot Street. Seems like something's being prepared there…

Description.SourceString: 来自<blue>柯林斯家族</>的挑衅

PanelDescription.SourceString: 塔吉多心心念念的环节要来了？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Is it time for the moment Taygedo's been dreaming of?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 另一边就交给鄙人。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: I'll take care of the other arrangements.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 柯林斯家族一代目，娜娜莉！来当你的对手！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: I'm Nanally, the Ichi-daime of The Coluccis! Here to face you head-on!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 不会让你伤到老大的一根毫毛！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: I won't let you lay a finger on the boss.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 没想到曾被称为桥间地的……唔，桥间地之……嗯嗯嗯……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: I can't believe the… umm… the one who Bridge Crossings once named… umm… once named…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 总之，没想到你会甘心做那小海獭的手下啊！让我会会你！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Anyway, I can't believe you'd willingly work for that otter! Let's see what you're made of!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （你们和塔吉多，各自编出来的设定也不知道有没有商量过……）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (I wonder if you and Taygedo ever bothered to coordinate your made-up backstories…)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 哇~~~异能者之间的战斗，太酷了！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Woah!!! A battle between Espers, it's so cool!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （加油！加油！鉴定师！不要输！）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Go, go, Appraiser! Don't lose!)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 不愧是有着……桥间地「无双之龙」名号的存在！够难缠的！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: As expected from… the Invincible Dragon of Bridge Crossings! You're one tough cookie!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 彼此彼此！桥间地……「轰雷之虎」！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Right back at you! The… Roaring Tiger of Bridge Crossings!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 噢——我还挺喜欢这个……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Ooh… I actually like this quite a bit…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 娜娜莉成为了你的对手，为了塔吉多老爷，击败作恶多端的桥间地「轰雷之虎」吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Nanally has become your opponent. For Sir Taygedo's sake, defeat the notorious Roaring Tiger of Bridge Crossings!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 娜娜莉的「演出」结束了，真是精彩到有些过分夸张的「谢幕」……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Nanally's performance has ended, with quite an over-the-top final bow…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 表演好像引发了一些事端，塔可对于「逃跑」的行为有些疑惑……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The performance seems to have stirred up some trouble, and Tako seems puzzled about someone running away…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 不论如何，方才没能防范到那两位仇家的靠近都是鄙人的疏忽，让老爷受惊了。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Nevertheless, I must apologize for my oversight in not preventing those two adversaries from approaching earlier. I'm sorry for causing you alarm, Sir.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （无妨！）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Don't worry about it!)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 塔吉多经常会碰到这种事吗？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Does this kind of thing happen to Taygedo often?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 这对我们来说是家常便饭，对吧老大？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: It's just another day at the office for us, right, boss?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （伊波恩……历经风风雨雨！）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Eibon… battle-hardened through thick and thin!)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （一点小事，不痛不痒！）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Minor hiccup, no sweat!)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 约会计划仍在进行，接下来的目的地是湛望角。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The date plan continues, with Azure Vista as the next destination.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 美好的景色让塔吉多和塔可都很开心，身为「老大」的塔吉多会发布新的任务吗？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The beautiful scenery has put both Taygedo and Tako in high spirits. Will Taygedo, as the boss, have a new quest for us?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 与阿德勒在此待命，有关约会计划的事情，阿德勒好像知道一些内情……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Wait here with Adler. It seems he knows something about what's really going on with this date plan…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 娜娜莉、早雾和埃德嘉为了「决胜告白」环节做好了准备，他们打算做些什么？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Nanally, Sakiri, and Edgar are ready for Operation Love Confession. What do they have in store?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 随心泥是塔吉多表演的重要一环，塔吉多正在等你……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Imaginadough is a crucial part of Taygedo's performance. Taygedo is waiting for you…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 塔吉多准备了什么表演呢？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: What kind of performance has Taygedo prepared?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 明明完成了相当不错的表演，塔吉多距离将心意说出口也只差那么一点……「随心泥」却突然失控了！？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Just as Taygedo pulled off a great performance and was so close to confessing… the Imaginadough suddenly went out of control!?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 虽然塔吉多的决胜告白失败了，但好在众人都没有受伤……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Though Taygedo's Operation Love Confession failed, at least everyone made it out unharmed…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 事情结束后，因为受到处罚，需要清理这一块的场地。塔吉多的恋爱还会有前途可言吗？问问伊波恩大家的想法吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: After everything that happened, we've been assigned to clean up this area as punishment. Is there still hope for Taygedo's love life? Let's ask what everyone thinks.

Description.LocalizedString: Go to the third floor of <blue>Acorn Apartments</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 前往卷叶榕大道的橡子公寓，拜访艺术家。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Go to Acorn Apartments on Fiscus Avenue to visit the artist.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 委托人似乎有些抗拒来访。向他说明来意，获得他的信任。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The client seems hesitant about visitors. Explain your purpose to gain his trust.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 这位艺术家看起来放下了戒备，向他了解更多细节吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The artist seems to have let his guard down. Ask him for more details.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 查看伊森提到的照片。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Check the photos Ethan mentioned.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 看过照片了，有些没头绪……听听看伊森的细节补充吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The photos don't tell us much… Let's hear what additional details Ethan has to share.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 已经和伊森约好了，等到约定时间（凌晨2点~3点）去找他吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: You've made plans with Ethan. Meet him during the arranged time (2:00–3:00 AM).

PanelDescription.SourceString: 这就是街头艺术？不明觉厉。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: So this is street art? I don't get it, but it looks awesome.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 我已经画好了。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: I've finished the painting.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 这就是街头艺术？不明觉厉。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: So this is street art? I don't get it, but it looks awesome.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 这幅画……感觉和之前的作品不太一样？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: This painting… feels a bit different from your previous works?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 与伊森商讨接下来的对策。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Discuss the next move with Ethan.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 在附近找一处掩人耳目的地方蹲守一下。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Find a secluded spot nearby to keep watch.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 波普为什么没现身？伊森说的保真吗？还是说漏掉了什么细节？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Why didn't Bopp show up? Can we trust what Ethan said? Or are we missing some details?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 对了，这面墙……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: By the way, this wall…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 再看看伊森昨晚画的涂鸦，究竟是哪里出了问题？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Take another look at Ethan's graffiti from last night. What exactly went wrong?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 伊森之前的涂鸦无一例外被破坏，而这次，「涂鸦怪」没有出现……这其中，应该有我还未察觉出的异常。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Ethan's previous graffiti was all destroyed without exception, but this time, the Graffiti Goof didn't appear… There must be an anomaly here that I haven't noticed yet.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 像伊森那样，拍张现场照片留证吧。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Like Ethan, take a photo of the scene as evidence.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 先拍下来总归没错。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Better take a photo just to be safe.

Description.LocalizedString: Go to the initial crime scene

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 接下来，去伊森拍摄的作品墙现场看看吧。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Next, let's go to the site of Ethan's artwork wall and take a look.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 去伊森提起的最初案发地，看看他的代表作，说不定能找到漏掉的线索。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Head to the original scene Ethan mentioned and check out his masterpiece. We might find some clues we missed.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 现场和照片比起来，还是直观多了。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Seeing it in person is much more intuitive than comparing it to photos.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 对了……这附近，说不定能找到其他线索。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Right… Maybe we can find other clues nearby.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 这位姑娘看起来是伊森的粉丝？说不定她知道些什么。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: That girl seems to be a fan of Ethan. Maybe she knows something.

Description.LocalizedString: Listen to what <blue>Brades</> has to say

PanelDescription.SourceString: 这位年龄在20~40岁之间的……男性，似乎有很多话想说。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: This guy, somewhere between 20 and 40, seems ready to talk.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 芮安提到欣赏伊森的理由，听起来并不是盲目跟风，布莱兹说得太过分了……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Riane's reasons for admiring Ethan seem genuine, not just blindly following trends. Brades was way too harsh…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 是布莱兹……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: It's Brades…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 芮安说，波普也破坏了其他人的涂鸦？这倒是出乎意料，赶紧去看看。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Riane says Bopp's been destroying other people's graffiti too? That's unexpected—we should check it out right away.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 这幅涂鸦，也是被波普破坏的。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: This graffiti was also destroyed by Bopp.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 仅凭观察，门外汉完全没有什么头绪啊……先把这处涂鸦拍下来吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Just by looking at it, an amateur like me can't make heads or tails of this… Better take a photo of this graffiti for now.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 看布莱兹又羞又恼的样子，该不会是涂鸦的作者吧？跟他聊聊，了解下发生了什么。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Brades looks both embarrassed and annoyed—could he be the graffiti artist? Let's talk to him and find out what happened.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （「在『涂鸦怪』眼里，我们的作品并没有区别」么……）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: ("No difference between our works"… huh…)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （说不定真是这样……）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Maybe that's really the case…)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 伊森说过，这附近是海特洛允许涂鸦的街区，应该也是波普出现的重灾区了。在附近搜寻下，看看有没有什么新线索吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Ethan mentioned this is one of Hethereau's designated graffiti zones, so it's probably where Bopp's been most active. Let's search the area for any new clues.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 不查不知道，一查真是出乎意料的展开啊。回去跟伊森商量接下来的对策吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: You never know until you look—this took quite an unexpected turn. Let's go back and discuss our next move with Ethan.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 屋内鼾声如雷，不知道的人还以为住了一头冬眠的熊……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The thunderous snoring from inside could easily be mistaken for a hibernating bear…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 将调查的结果告诉眼前这个睡眼惺忪的男人……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Time to share our findings with this drowsy fellow…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 等到约定时间（凌晨2点~3点）去找伊森。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Meet with Ethan during the arranged time (2:00–3:00 AM).

PanelDescription.SourceString: 等到约定时间（凌晨2点~3点）去找伊森。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Meet with Ethan during the arranged time (2:00–3:00 AM).

PanelDescription.SourceString: 伊森很好地完成了嘱托。接下来该让他回家休息了。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Ethan has fulfilled his task perfectly. Time to let him head home and get some rest.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 现身吧，波普。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Show yourself, Bopp.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 波普果然出现了，打败它！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: There's Bopp, just as expected! Take it down!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 终于等到你了……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Finally, I've been waiting for you…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 波普果然出现了，打败它！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: There's Bopp, just as expected! Take it down!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 波普果然出现了，打败它！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: There's Bopp, just as expected! Take it down!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 伊森今晚还能睡着吗？赶紧去告诉他，干扰他创作的梦魇已经消失了。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I wonder if Ethan can get any sleep tonight? Let's hurry and tell him that the nightmare disrupting his art is finally gone.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 伊森今晚还能睡着吗？赶紧去告诉他，干扰他创作的梦魇已经消失了。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I wonder if Ethan can get any sleep tonight? Let's hurry and tell him that the nightmare disrupting his art is finally gone.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 委托完成了，与伊森告别离开吧，让他安心回房间睡个好觉。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The commission is complete. Say goodbye to Ethan and let him get back to his room for a good night's rest.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 委托完成了，与伊森告别离开吧，让他安心回房间睡个好觉。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The commission is complete. Say goodbye to Ethan and let him get back to his room for a good night's rest.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （呲溜——呲溜——）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Slurp… slurp…)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 谢谢小雪人！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Thank you, little Snowman!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 今年海特洛热得像个炉子，要不是你舔舐发烫的车座，我都不敢出远门。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Hethereau has been as hot as an oven. I am only able to travel far because you licked my scorching seats!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 冰淇淋都送给你！希望你吃得开心！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: All my ice cream is yours! Hope you enjoy it!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 想要提前召唤冬雪，就要积攒能「冰冻整座城市」的「冷气」。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: To summon winter snow early, you need to gather enough cold air to freeze the entire city.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 陪小帕创造一场奇迹，让这座城市在夏天下雪！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Help Puff create a miracle and make this city snow in summer!

QuestName.LocalizedString: Part-Time Work Starting with Customer Service

PanelDescription.SourceString: 小帕想靠自己的努力来打造冬天，就像在荒野上盖小房子，每块砖都是自己选的。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Puff wants to create winter through his own hard work, like building a house in the wilderness where every brick is carefully paved by hand.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 帮小帕和店员争取工作，一定要重点强调它的卖萌优势。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Help Puff negotiate with the staff for work. Make sure to emphasize his adorable charm as a key advantage.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 帕噜噜噜！！！（呀嘿——给帕活过来呀——帕噜！）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Puff puff puff! (Hyaa! Wake up! Don't sleep on Puff!)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 发，发生什么事了？！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Wh-what just happened?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 面试成功后，帕开始上岗营业！坏了，客流量为什么反而在骤减……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: After passing the interview, Puff starts working! Oh no, why is the customer flow suddenly dropping instead…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （客户，记得帮帕拍照！）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Remember to take pictures of Puff!)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （猫丸味增拉面~大量猫毛里的少量拉面~喵呜呜呜~）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Nekomaru miso ramen! Lots of cat hair and much less noodles! Meow-wow-wow!)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （欸？客人怎么反倒走了？）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Wait, why are customers leaving?)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （猫丸味增拉面~鲜到想挠墙的拉面~帕噜噜噜~）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Nekomaru miso ramen! It's so tasty, it's wall-scratching tasty! Puuuufffff!)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 打开美颜，打开滤镜，拍下帕认真工作的样子。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Turn on portrait mode, apply filters, and capture Puff hard at work.

QuestName.SourceString: 飘着「假发」的美味秘制拉面
QuestName.LocalizedString: Delicious Secret Recipe Ramen with Floating "Hair"

PanelDescription.SourceString: 享用完热腾腾的拉面后，再去海鲜店碰碰运气。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: After enjoying some hot ramen, head to the seafood shop to try your luck.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 海鲜店的冰鲜送货车，是积蓄冷气的不二之选！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The seafood shop's refrigerated delivery truck is the perfect choice for storing up cold air!

QuestName.LocalizedString: You Can Never Be Too Careful with People

PanelDescription.SourceString: 吃一堑长一智，有过多次受骗经历后，现在海鲜店主的防备心像螃蟹壳一样硬。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Once bitten, twice shy. After being deceived so many times, the seafood shop owner's guard is now as hard as a crab shell.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 用押金来摧毁海鲜店主的意志。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Use the deposit to crush the seafood shop owner's resolve.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 自费上班？这等好事令海鲜店主都开始怦然心动！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Paying to work? Such a sweet deal is making even the seafood shop owner's heart flutter!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 找到冷冻货车，记得先检查油箱，毕竟接下来要跑一整天呢。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Find the refrigerated truck and remember to check the fuel tank first. After all, you'll be driving all day long.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （帕噜——客户！好拉风的冷冻车！快，帕要跟它合影~）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Puff! What a cool refrigerated truck! Quick, Puff wants a picture with it!)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 拍下小帕兴奋的样子。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Take a photo of Puff's excited expression.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 油门一踩，行人闪避！这批海鲜，定要活蹦乱跳地送进客户的手里！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Step on the gas and dodge pedestrians! This batch of seafood must be delivered fresh and lively into the buyers' hands!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （好冷啊！吸溜~吸溜~，用这条带鱼做帕的新围巾怎么样？）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (So cold! Slurp, slurp! Puff wants to wear this cutlassfish as a scarf!)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 小帕，别在车厢里滚来滚去……我开车会分心的。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Puff, stop rolling around in the back… it's distracting.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （帕开心嘛~来海特洛以后，帕还没有像现在这样，待在这么有「安全感」的地方过呢。简直像睡在雪山肚子里一样「安心」。）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (But Puff is happy! Puff has never been at a safer place since arriving at Hethereau! It's like sleeping in the belly of a snowy mountain, so peaceful!)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 一直没问过你，之前生活很辛苦吧？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: I never asked you before, but life was pretty tough for you, wasn't it?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （当然！雪人出现在夏天，超多烦恼的！）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Of course! Being a Snowman in summer is tough!)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （总有满头大汗的路人偷偷靠近帕，突然咬一口帕的屁股！哇！坏蛋！雪人的屁股不能吃啦！）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (There are always sweaty people who sneak up and take a bite out of my butt! Hey meanies, you can't eat a Snowman's butt!)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: ……嗯。也许是好奇帕是什么「口味」的？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Hmm… maybe they're curious about your flavor?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （反正屁股那里是榴莲味。）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Well, my butt is durian flavor.)
Oh…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （刚开始，帕不知道怎么收集冷气，身无分文，肚子饿饿，就去许愿池捞硬币，但帕是冰淇淋体质耶，一碰水就化掉了。气！）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (At first, Puff didn't know how to collect cold air. Puff was broke and hungry, and had to collect pennies from the wishing pool. Puff has an ice cream body and melts in water. So frustrating!)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 那真的很惨了，雪生走不了捷径。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: That's rough. It's not easy for a Snowman like you.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 不过帕很坚强呢。从来不哭，笑容灿烂又治愈，大家都有被鼓励到。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: But you're really strong, Puff. You never cry, and your bright smile encourages and heals everyone around you.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （帕不敢哭，遇水会融化啦！帕噜。）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Puff doesn't dare cry! Puff will melt in water! Puff!)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: ……辛苦了。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: That must be difficult.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （帕也不敢睡觉，睡着了，万一咔叽玛里，有人偷偷用帕的屁股蘸薯条呢？）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Puff can't sleep either! What if someone in Clicky tries to dip their French fries in Puff's durian ice cream?)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 你现在可以依赖我，安心睡一觉吧。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: You can rely on me now. Go get some sleep.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （呜哇——客户好讨厌，这下帕要哭啦！）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Waaah! Puff is gonna cry!)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 路况良好，开得比预想的快，似乎闻到炸锅里的油香了，等会一定要蹭根现炸薯条尝尝。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Road conditions are good, and we're approaching faster than expected. I can already smell the oil from the fryer… I'll definitely have to snag some fresh french fries when I get there.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 车厢里时不时传来小帕的轻鼾……呃，重鼾。听不到导航语音了。凭感觉开吧……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: I hear Puff's light snoring… umm, heavy snoring, from the passenger seat. I can't hear the GPS anymore. Guess I'll just have to drive with my instinct…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （zzZz……ZZZz……）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (zzZz… ZZZz…)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （夏刑草嗯呜……等帕救嗯嘛嘛嘛……）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Solifugae Vita… mmph… gotta save… mmm…)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 在说什么梦话？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: What are you mumbling about?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （哎呀呀，帕的头。磕得好痛！客户倒是开稳点。）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Ow ow ow, Puff's head! That really hurt! Could you drive more carefully?)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 醒了？那就聊聊天吧，一个人开车有点无聊。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: You're awake? Let's chat a bit. Driving by myself is boring.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 现在可以告诉我了吗？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Can you tell me now?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 这么努力地收集冷气。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Working so hard to collect cold air.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 是为了什么……才想在夏天降下一场雪？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Why do you want to make it snow in summer?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （zzzz~zzzz~zzzz~）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (zzzz…zzzz…zzzz…)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 开始装睡了，看来还是不想回答。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Huh, pretending to sleep. Seems like you still don't want to answer.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 得再抓紧些，牛油锅底已经咕嘟咕嘟滚开，客人的筷子望眼欲穿，就在等这批海鲜呢。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Better pick up the pace! The beef tallow broth is already bubbling away, and the customers are waiting with chopsticks in hand, eager for this batch of seafood.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （要去卜多力小屋了吗？帕噜噜噜，好怀念！）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Are we going to Budoriya? Oh Puff, so nostalgic!)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （说起来，之前帕和友人流浪的时候，还被千代婆婆收留过一阵子呢。）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Come to think of it, when Puff was wandering around with a friend, Granny Chiyo took us in for a while.)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （千代婆婆专门购置了一台冰箱，给帕做小床，卜多力也每天给帕做冷食吃。）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Granny Chiyo bought Puff a refrigerator as a little bed, while Budori fed Puff cold food every day.)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （不过卜多力似乎有点高度近视？总是把帕的脸当成饭团，在手心里捏来捏去。）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Budori seems to be nearsighted though? Always mistook Puff's face for a rice ball and kept squishing Puff around.)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （啊啊……卜多力是章鱼，手手又很多。帕的脸，每天扁扁。）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Ah… Budori is an octopus with many hands. Puff's face got squished flat every day.)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （真怀念啊，那样灯火通明，客人们的啤酒花相继撞出来的日子。）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Puff really misses those days… The place all lit up, with beer glasses clanking into each other.)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 那为什么还要离开卜多力小屋，继续去流浪呢？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Why did you leave Budoriya to wander around?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （帕有不得不去做的事。帕噜。）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Puff had something Puff had to do.)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 这批海鲜刺身送到时，店里的灯笼已经亮起，客人的第一杯啤酒也刚好见底。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: By the time this batch of sashimi arrives, the restaurant's lanterns are already glowing, and the customers have just finished their first beers.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （噗噜 噗噜噜 ~）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Puffupuffupuffupuffu…)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 帕开始唱歌了……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Puff started singing…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （不同季节  跳起同一支舞 ）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Across the seasons, we danced cheek to cheek.)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （地轴倾转瞬间 舞步终将重叠 ）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (When the Earth takes a tilt, our steps will then meet.)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （月光小船划破银雪……  ）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (A moonlight boat glides on silver snow…)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 耳塞呢？？我的降噪耳塞呢……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Where are my noise-canceling earbuds…?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （哼！客户太小瞧帕了。帕也是参加过livehouse的！）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Hey! Don't look down on Puff! Puff has been to a livehouse before!)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 你是乐手？还是观众？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: As a musician or an audience?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （呃……问这么细干嘛！帕当然是去打工的……就是当氛围造雪机啦！往人群里噗噗放冷气的，帕噜。）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Ugh, why ask so many questions? Puff was there for work… as an atmospheric snow machine! Just puffing cold air into the crowd! Puff!)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 帕的生活经历很丰富呢。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: You've really been through a lot!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （当然，帕和友人一起走过很多地方。）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Of course! Puff went to many places with Puff's friend.)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 但可以的话……可以先不唱吗。我在开车，没手捂耳朵呢。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: But if possible… can you not sing right now? I can't cover my ears when I'm driving.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （什么？客户你说什么？帕在车厢里，听——不——见——）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (What? What did you say? Puff is in the back of the car and can't—hear—you!)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （ ~噗噜 噗噜噜 ~）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Puffupuffupuffupuffu!)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 好的。坐稳了，海特洛车神要加速了。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Hold on tight, the God Racer of Hethereau is about to speed up.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （呀噜噜噜噜！！不唱了不唱了……客户，把油门从脚上挪开，呕！帕晕车了，帕要吐了哇。）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Puffuffufuufuu! Puff will stop singing! Hey, get your foot off the gas pedal! Ugh! Puff is going to throw up!)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 开车一天，浑身疲惫，快回海鲜店复命吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: After driving all day, I'm completely exhausted. Better head back to the seafood shop to report in.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 货已全部送达，去找店主退回之前的押金。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: All deliveries are complete. Time to find the shop owner and get my deposit back.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 店主一开口，心中就警铃大震，总感觉有坏事要发生……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The moment the shop owner opens their mouth, alarm bells start ringing in my head. I can't shake the feeling that something bad is about to happen…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 听说金苹果藏馆正在举办冰雕展，为了冷气不得不去看看了。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I heard the Golden Apple Collection Hall is hosting an ice sculpture exhibition. I absolutely have to check it out… for the air conditioning, of course.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （帕从友人那听说过很多异象趣闻和豪门八卦，客户有想了解的，随便问帕！）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Puff heard many anomaly stories and wealthy family gossip from Puff's friend. If you want to know anything, just ask Puff!)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 这些展品都很有意思。比如这枚金币……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: These exhibits are very interesting, like this gold coin…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 那这把菜刀……谁会把菜刀放在展馆里啊。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: And this kitchen knife… why is it even being displayed?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 参观藏馆，德沃夏克家族展现出来的财富与胸襟，令人起敬。在这里，黄金与慈悲同样熠熠生辉。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Visiting the Collection Hall, the wealth and magnanimity displayed by the Dvořák family is truly jaw-dropping. Here, gold and compassion shine equally bright.

QuestName.LocalizedString: Cold Air Fully Charged, Luck Overflowing!

Description.LocalizedString: Talk to <blue>Puff</> in front of the ice sculptures

BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Hmm…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 帕更加期待冰雕了！帕都不敢想，它会有多震撼！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Puff is even more excited about the ice sculptures! Puff can't imagine how amazing they'll be!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 小帕吸饱了冷气，自信表示，「夏天的雪」一定会成功降临。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Puff absorbed plenty of cold air and confidently declared that "summer snow" would definitely fall successfully.

QuestName.LocalizedString: Group Photo: Puff and Mr. Romantic

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （等等……帕换个姿势。）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Wait… let Puff change to another pose.)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （看，帕模仿情种先生，酷吧！）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Look, Puff is imitating Mr. Romantic. Isn't Puff cool?)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 酷。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Cool.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 拍下小帕模仿「情种先生冰雕」的样子。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Take a photo of Puff imitating the "Mr. Romantic" ice sculpture.

Description.SourceString: 与<blue>奇怪的手套管家</>交谈

PanelDescription.SourceString: 被奇怪的手套管家拦住了去路，必须说出冰雕的一百种优点才能离开。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The strange gloved butler has blocked your path and you must list one hundred advantages of ice sculptures before you can leave.

QuestName.LocalizedString: The Wind Remembers We Were Here

Description.SourceString: 搭乘电梯前往<blue>上晴塔天台</>
Description.LocalizedString: Take the elevator to the <blue>Hethereau Skytower Rooftop</>

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 接下来去哪儿呢？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Where should we go next?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （客户，跟帕走，这次帕带你去一个地方！）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Follow Puff! Puff will take you to a place!)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 陪帕去上晴塔，看看海特洛最高处的风景。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Accompany Puff to Hethereau Skytower to see the view from the highest point in Hethereau.

QuestName.LocalizedString: The Wind Remembers We Were Here

Description.SourceString: 搭乘电梯前往<blue>上晴塔天台</>
Description.LocalizedString: Take the elevator to the <blue>Hethereau Skytower Rooftop</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 陪帕去上晴塔，看看海特洛最高处的风景。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Accompany Puff to Hethereau Skytower to see the view from the highest point in Hethereau.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 小帕似乎没见过真正的雪，「降雪演习」失败。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Puff seems to have never seen real snow. The "snow drill" failed.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 拍下小帕热爱生活的样子。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Take a photo of Puff's love for life.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 和小帕约定明天在水菱湖边见面。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Made plans with Puff to meet by Caltrop Lake tomorrow.

Description.LocalizedString: Wait patiently (<blue>10:00 AM. the next day</>)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 现在已经是第二天10点了，出发去找小帕吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: It's now 10:00 a.m. the next day. Time to go find Puff.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: ……竟然真的下雪了！好美啊。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: It's really snowing… It's beautiful.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 去找小帕吧。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Let's go find Puff.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 真的见证了「夏天的雪」！海特洛又发生了美妙的事，快去水菱湖边和小帕分享这个奇迹。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I really witnessed summer snow! A miracle has happened in Hethereau again! Quick, go to Caltrop Lake and share this moment with Puff.

QuestName.LocalizedString: The Street Where Only You Are Missing

Description.SourceString: 向路人探听<blue>小帕</>的下落
向路人探听<blue>小帕</>的下落
向路人探听<blue>小帕</>的下落

PanelDescription.SourceString: 这场大雪无人缺席 ，消失的只有小雪人的踪迹。似乎奇迹与遗憾的事……正在同时发生。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Everyone witnessed this great snowfall, but the little snowman's traces have vanished. It seems that miracles and regrets… are simultaneous…

QuestName.LocalizedString: The Gods Spilled Their Ice Cream

PanelDescription.SourceString: 小帕不见了，等等……这雪甜丝丝的，竟然是冰淇淋？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Puff is gone, but wait… this snow tastes sweet! It's actually ice cream?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 所有人都在，为什么只有小帕不见了……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Everyone's here, so why is only Puff missing…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 哪里不对劲……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Something is not right…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 漏掉了什么重要的东西……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: I'm missing something important…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 在雪人的泯除地，人们发现了新生异象「夏刑草」，这种异象只能在极寒环境下才能生存，夏天则会泯灭为枯枝。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: At the snowman's nullification site, people discovered a new Anomaly called "Solifugae Vita." This anomaly can only survive in extremely cold environments and withers into dead branches during summer.

Description.SourceString: 在<blue>湖边</>调查小帕的踪迹

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 不同季节   跳起同一支舞  地轴倾转瞬间  舞步终将重叠
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString:
Across the seasons, we danced cheek to cheek.
When the Earth takes a tilt, our steps will then meet.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 月光小船划破银雪   你是航线   也是春天
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString:
A moonlight boat glides on silver snow,
You're my compass, my springtime glow.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 我会用力奔赴  哪怕化作繁星点点
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: And I'll rush hard to you, even if I turn to starlit sand.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 在管理局之前的判定中，夏刑草已经泯除。而就在这场「意外」的雪到来之际——它重新开始呼吸。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: In the Bureau's previous assessment, Solifugae Vita had been nullified. But with the arrival of this "unexpected" snow—it began breathing again.

Description.SourceString: 在<blue>湖边</>调查小帕的踪迹

PanelDescription.SourceString: 在管理局之前的判定中，夏刑草已经泯除。而就在这场「意外」的雪到来之际——它重新开始呼吸。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: In the Bureau's previous assessment, Solifugae Vita had been nullified. But with the arrival of this "unexpected" snow—it began breathing again.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 夏刑草，一直以树枝的形态陪伴在小帕身边，因气息微弱，以致于被所有人忽略。而它……正是小帕费心打造出这个冬天的原因。用一生的雪，为你缝件月光袍。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Solifugae Vita had always accompanied Puff in the form of branches, its presence so faint that everyone overlooked it. And it… was precisely the reason Puff painstakingly created this winter. With a lifetime of snow, to sew you a robe of moonlight.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 嘿，夏刑草，今年我也没有辜负每一天哦。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Hey, old friend, I didn't waste a single day this year either!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 真笨啊……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: How silly of me…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 还是把雪下成冰淇淋了呢。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: You somehow managed to make it snow ice cream.

QuestName.LocalizedString: Gift for the Little Book Lover

PanelDescription.SourceString: 报刊亭店主递来一张订购单。应该只要填写一下就好吧……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The newsstand owner handed me an order form. I just need to fill it out…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 桌上的日记上传来了异象的气息。最好把这件事告诉店主。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The diary on the desk emanates an anomalous presence. I should tell the shop owner about this.

Description.LocalizedString: Wait until the next day (<blue>10:00 AM - 06:00 PM</>)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 帮埃德嘉订购的杂志，要什么时候才能到货呢？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: When will the magazine for Edgar arrive?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 收到了报刊亭店主万理发来的短信。是杂志到货了吗？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Just received a message from Miles, the newsstand owner. Did the magazine arrive?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （是输入法出问题了吗？还是……）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Is there something wrong with my keyboard? Or is it…)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （有点不好的预感。还是尽快去店里看看吧。）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (I have a bad feeling about this. I should go check on the shop as soon as possible.)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 短信的内容看上去有些奇怪……还是先去店里看看情况吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The message content seems a bit strange… Let's head to the shop and see what's going on.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 万理先生？……不在店里吗。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Miles? …He's not in the shop?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 到达了报刊亭，万理却不在店内。四处张望后，桌上的东西让人有些在意……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I arrived at the newsstand, but Miles isn't in the shop. After looking around, something on the desk catches my attention…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 等了一段时间，万理终于回到了报刊亭。但他的样子好像怪怪的……是错觉吗？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: After waiting for a while, Miles finally returned to the newsstand. Something about him seems strange though… am I imagining things?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （……刚刚一瞬间，日记上的异象气息变强了？）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (…Just now for a moment, did the anomaly aura from the diary get stronger?)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （万理先生的状态也很不对劲。不能让他这样独自待着。）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Miles's being really off too. I can't leave him alone like this.)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 万理突然急匆匆地离开了报刊亭。他要去哪里？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Miles suddenly rushed out of the newsstand in a hurry. Where is he going?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 怎么还没来啊……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Why aren't they here yet…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 真是的，明明急得不行的是她，怎么又放我鸽子！再不来，下次别想借我作业抄了！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Seriously! She was the one who was so urgent about this, so why is she standing me up again! If she doesn't show up soon, she can forget about copying my homework next time!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 总算追上了突然离开的万理。看他的样子，好像在等人？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Finally caught up with Miles after he suddenly left. From the looks of it, he seems to be waiting for someone?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 真过意不去，又要劳烦你跑一趟。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: I really feel bad about this, making you go through all this trouble again.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 我这毛病，到底是怎么回事……之后得抽个时间上医院看看了。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: What's wrong with me, anyway… I should find some time to go to the hospital and get this checked out.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 奔波一早，万理泡好的茶还没来得及喝上一口。还是先回报刊亭吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: After running around all morning, Miles hasn't even had a chance to take a sip of the tea he brewed. We should head back to the newsstand first.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 店里有一位客人在等待，看装扮似乎是「惊喜匣子！」礼品店的店员。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: There's a customer waiting in the shop. From their outfit, they seem to be staff from the Surprise Box Gift Shop.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 这一系列异常事件的由头，或许就是那本散发异象气息的日记……把对现状的想法告诉万理吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The root of these strange incidents might just be that diary emanating an anomalous aura… Let's share my thoughts on the current situation with Miles.

Description.LocalizedString: Wait until the next day (<blue>10:00 AM - 06:00 PM</>)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 万理已经承诺不再翻阅那本日记，但愿一切异状能够就此平息……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Miles has promised not to read through that diary anymore. Hopefully all the strange occurrences will settle down now…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 万理又发来了短信，这次的内容似乎更加奇怪……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Miles sent another message, and this time the content seems even stranger…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 上次店主身上出现异状时，也发送了这种乱码短信……得赶紧过去看看。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: The last time something strange happened to the shop owner, he sent garbled messages like this too… I need to get over there quickly.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 从这些短信看，事态似乎恶化了。最好尽快赶去店里。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Judging from these messages, the situation seems to be getting worse. Let's get to the shop as quickly as possible.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 报刊亭里一反常态地一片狼藉。店内有一位陌生少女，她会不会知道些什么？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The newsstand is unusually messy and in complete disarray. There's a strange girl inside the shop… I wonder if she knows something?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 一名中年男子带着万理回到了店里。本以为只是一起微不足道的异象事件，现在却有越来越多的人被牵扯其中……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: A middle-aged man brought Miles back to the shop. What I thought was just an insignificant Anomaly incident is now dragging more and more people into it…

PanelDescription.SourceString: J.T.F队员迅速赶来了现场。把事情的前因后果告知他们吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Members of JTF quickly arrived at the scene. Let me fill them in on everything that happened.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 知远被说服后，长歌非常感动。和她聊聊接下来的打算吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: After convincing Kilos, Aria was deeply moved. Let's talk to her about what she plans to do next.

Description.LocalizedString: Wait until the next day (<blue>10:00 AM - 06:00 PM</>)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 已经没有什么能做了。安心等待长歌的联络吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: There's nothing more to do. Wait patiently for Aria to get in touch.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 收到了万理的短信……以他目前认知异常的情况，会发来什么样的内容？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Received a message from Miles… Given his current cognitive abnormalities, what could he possibly send?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 读完了知远用父亲账号发来的信息。事不宜迟，这就前往报刊亭吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Finished reading the message Kilos sent from his father's account. There's no time to waste, let's head to the newsstand right away.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 长歌早已等在店里了。先听听她准备的作战计划吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Aria is already waiting in the shop. Let's hear what plan she's prepared.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 按照日记记载，万理爷爷接到奶奶之后，两人一起去了附近的广场。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: According to the diary, after Grandpa Miles picked up Grandma, the two of them went to the nearby plaza together.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 当年，广场好像是很受孩子们欢迎的游乐场所。奶奶周末经常去那边，用零花钱买些饲料，在广场上喂鸽子。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Back then, the plaza seemed to be a popular playground for kids. Grandma would often go there on weekends, using her pocket money to buy feed and feeding the pigeons in the plaza.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 不过，几十年过去，随着城市规划变动，广场早搬迁去了别的地方。广场原本在的地方，现在已经变成了商业区……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: However, after several decades, with changes in city planning, the plaza was relocated somewhere else long ago. Where the plaza used to be has now become a commercial district…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 啊，到了！就是那边。万理爷爷也停下脚步了……看来我的调查没错嘛！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Ah, we're here! It's over there. Grandpa Miles stopped walking too… Looks like my research was right!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 万理离开了报刊亭，向回忆中的地点进发。按照长歌的计划，现在只能跟上他，静观其变。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Miles left the newsstand and headed toward a place from his memories. According to Aria's plan, all I can do now is follow him and wait to see what happens.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 万理到达了他回忆中的「广场」——现在已经是一座气派的办公楼了。接下来他作何打算……还是先观望一下吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Miles has reached what he remembered as the "plaza"—now it's an impressive office building. What will he do next…? I should just wait and see for now.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 总算解开了误会，和万理一同离开了办公楼，但他似乎仍心虑疑虑……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: We finally cleared up the misunderstanding and left the office building together with Miles, but he still seems troubled…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 接下来……日记里说，奶奶和万理爷爷去了附近的报刊亭，买新到货的漫画杂志。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Next… the diary says that Grandma went to a nearby newsstand with Grandpa Miles to buy newly arrived manga magazines.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 真难想象他们年轻的时候也跟我们一样，会追漫画连载啊……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: It's hard to imagine that when they were young, they were just like us, following manga series…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 虽然时代不同，但毕竟都是年轻人，共同点说不定意外很多呢。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Even though it was a different era, they were still young people after all. We might have more in common than we'd expect.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 对了，当年的那家报刊亭似乎也早早关门了。现在在原本报刊亭位置的……我没搞错的话，应该是一家抽风猫奶茶店吧？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Come to think of it, that newsstand from back then closed down pretty early too. What's at the original newsstand location now… if I'm not mistaken, should be a Crazy Cat bubble tea shop, right?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 万理继续向日记记载中的地方进发。不知五十年后，那个地点又发生了什么变化……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Miles continues toward the place mentioned in the diary. I wonder what changes have happened to that location after fifty years…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 万理的言行让抽风猫奶茶店的店员一头雾水。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Miles's words and actions left the Crazy Cat staff completely bewildered.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 这边大概也行不通了吧。我看看，嗯……直接去下一个地方吧……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: This place probably won't work either. Let me see, hmm… let's just go to the next location…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 下一个地点是？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: What's the next location?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 是咖啡店。很巧——五十年后，这个地址竟然还是一家咖啡店！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: It's a coffee shop. What a coincidence! After fifty years, this address is still a coffee shop!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 虽然不是同一家品牌了……怎么说呢，物是人非的感觉还真是让人感慨呢。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Though it's not the same brand anymore… How should I put it, seeing how everything's changed while staying the same really makes you feel nostalgic.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 世间竟有如此巧合——五十年前是咖啡店的地方，如今依旧是咖啡店……只是店铺早已换了主人。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: What a remarkable coincidence. The place that was a café fifty years ago is still a café today… though the shop has long since changed hands.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 咖啡店里还有空位。和长歌一起入座，整理一下现状吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: There are still empty seats in the café. Let's sit down with Aria and sort out the current situation.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 长歌提出了一个……有些天马行空的计划，但眼下似乎也别无他法。来都来了，试试看吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Aria proposed a plan that's… somewhat far-fetched, but it seems like we don't have any other options right now. Since we're already here, let's give it a shot.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 万理爷爷离开了……应该是去今天的最后一个地方了吧。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Grandpa Miles has left… He's probably going to his last stop for today.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 从咖啡店出来时，太阳已经快落山了。奶奶把要乘车离开海特洛市的万理爷爷送到了车站。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: When we came out of the coffee shop, the sun was already setting. Grandma escorted Grandpa Miles, who was leaving Hethereau by bus, to the station.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 两人在车站等待着，像往常一样闲聊……然后，车来了。万理爷爷上了车，奶奶向他挥手道别。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: The two of them waited at the station, chatting as usual… Then the bus arrived. Grandpa Miles got on, and Grandma waved goodbye to him.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: ……就算想要再劝劝万理爷爷，我们好像也插不上手了。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: …Even if we wanted to try convincing Grandpa Miles again, it seems like there's nothing we can do now.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 根据日记记载，五十年前的那一天，万理和千秋的旅程即将迎来终点。无论如何，这场故事的帷幕终将落下。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: According to the diary entries, on that day fifty years ago, Miles and Millen's journey was about to reach its end.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 暮色沉沉，车站无声地伫立在夕阳的余晖里。远处，列车就要来了。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: As dusk falls, the station stands silently in the lingering glow of the sunset. In the distance, a train approaches…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 暮色沉沉，车站无声地伫立在夕阳的余晖里。远处，列车就要来了。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: As dusk falls, the station stands silently in the lingering glow of the sunset. In the distance, a train approaches…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 暮色沉沉，车站无声地伫立在夕阳的余晖里。远处，列车就要来了。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: As dusk falls, the station stands silently in the lingering glow of the sunset. In the distance, a train approaches…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 少女千秋透明的身影消失了，万理却突然倒在了站台上……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Millen's transparent figure vanished, but Miles suddenly collapsed on the platform…

Description.LocalizedString: Patiently wait for <blue> the next day between 10 am to 6 pm</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 「旧日记」已经泯除，事情告一段落。安心等待大家的联络吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The Old Diary has been nullified, and the matter has come to an end. Just wait for everyone to get in touch.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 恢复过来的万理发来了短信。快看看他现在状况如何吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Miles has recovered and sent a message. Let's see how he's doing now.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 报刊亭里很是热闹。没有任何真实存在的人或日记受到伤害，真是太好了。正好，和万理聊聊这次的事件吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The newsstand is bustling! It's great that no real people or diaries were harmed. Perfect timing to chat with Miles about what happened.

Description.SourceString: 交互异象展品<blue>「灯」</>并进入<blue>展厅参观</>
Description.LocalizedString: Interact with the Anomaly exhibit <blue>"Lamp"</> and enter the <blue>Exhibition Hall</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 小小的灯泡也会是一个异象空间的入口，很奇妙吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Even a tiny lightbulb can be an entrance to an Anomalous Realm. Pretty magical, isn't it?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 「金苹果」藏馆内的神奇异象展品「灯」正在展出中，展厅内的神秘介绍员正在等待今天的第一位游客。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The magical Anomaly exhibit "Lamp" is currently on display at the Gold Apple Collection Hall, and a mysterious guide in the exhibition hall is waiting for today's first visitor.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 钨丝先生体贴地指明了探索道路，向着光照亮的地方，前进吧！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Tungsten thoughtfully shows the way to explore. Head toward where the light shines, let's go!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 红蔷薇，白蔷薇，
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Red roses, white roses,

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 三个花盆高高堆。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Three pots stacked to the sky.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 红房子，白围墙，
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Red houses, white walls,

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 我们来玩捉迷藏。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Hide and seek, shall we try?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 衣柜里，床底下，
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: In closets, under beds,

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 妈妈找不到我啦。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Mother won't find me today.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 秋千啊，晃呀晃，
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: The swing rocks back and forth,

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 妈妈快快回来吧。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Mother, please don't stay away.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 钨丝先生体贴地指明了探索道路，向着光照亮的地方，前进吧！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Tungsten thoughtfully shows the way to explore. Head toward where the light shines, let's go!

PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Tungsten thoughtfully shows the way to explore. Head toward where the light shines, let's go!

QuestName.LocalizedString: The Girl Who Sings Nursery Rhymes

Description.LocalizedString: Talk to the <blue>girl on the swing</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 曲调诡谲的童谣、吱呀作响的秋千和神秘黑影，那位坐在秋千上的女孩或许知道点什么。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: A nursery rhyme with a sinister melody, a creaking swing, and mysterious shadows… That girl sitting on the swing might know something.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 不礼貌的女孩说完就匆匆走了，反而更显得可疑，跟上去看看吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The rude girl hurried off after speaking, only makeing her seem more suspicious. Let's follow her and see what's up.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 无法进入的房屋……钨丝先生说过这里有「两个世界」，试试钨丝先生给的道具吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: A house that can't be entered… Tungsten mentioned there are "two worlds" here. Let's try using the item Tungsten gave us.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 与女孩的家一模一样的房子，但似乎更加陈旧……问问附近的建筑工人有没有线索吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: A house that looks exactly like the girl's home, but it seems much more run-down… Let's ask the construction workers nearby if they have any clues.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 难搞的大设计师就在眼前，或许她会知道发生了什么。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The so-called difficult great designer is right in front of us. Perhaps she'll know what happened.

Description.LocalizedString: Go to the <blue>park</> to gather inspiration

PanelDescription.SourceString: 帕蒂女士主动提出担任导游，恭敬不如从命，采风旅途第一站——公园，出发！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Ms. Patty offered to be our guide, and it would be rude to refuse. First stop on our inspiration-gathering journey: the park. Let's go!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 就是这里，快二十年未见，这里倒是变化不大。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Here we are. It's been almost twenty years, but it hasn't changed much.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 呼——熟悉的味道，只是站在这里就觉得变年轻了呢。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Ah… that familiar smell. Just standing here makes me feel young again.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 不管别的，先单纯逛逛公园如何？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Let's take a simple stroll around the park, shall we?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 公园里的设施还真不少，滑梯、健身器材、摇摇椅、秋千，来都来了不如都看看吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: There are quite a few facilities in this park: slides, exercise equipment, rocking chairs, swings. Since we're already here, might as well check them all out.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 小时候总觉得滑梯很高也很长，现在看原来这么矮啊。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: As a kid, I always thought this slide was tall and long. Looking at it now, it's actually pretty short.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 公园里的设施还算齐全，滑梯、健身器材、摇摇椅、秋千，来都来了不如都看看吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The park has a fairly complete set of facilities: slides, exercise equipment, rocking chairs, swings. Since we're already here, might as well check them all out.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 这些健身器材小孩子都不爱玩，上面总会长出被子来。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Kids never want to play on this exercise equipment. They tend to be covered in blankets.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 公园里的设施还算齐全，滑梯、健身器材、摇摇椅、秋千，来都来了不如都看看吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The park has a fairly complete set of facilities: slides, exercise equipment, rocking chairs, swings. Since we're already here, might as well check them all out.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 啊，现在的我可坐不进这个摇椅了。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Ah, there's no way I could fit in this chair anymore.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 公园里的设施还算齐全，滑梯、健身器材、摇摇椅、秋千，来都来了不如都看看吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The park has a fairly complete set of facilities: slides, exercise equipment, rocking chairs, swings. Since we're already here, might as well check them all out.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 在沁人心脾的花香中，帕蒂女士似乎有了些想法，和帕蒂聊聊吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Surrounded by the refreshing floral fragrance, Ms. Patty seems to have some ideas. Let's have a chat with Patty.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 帕蒂信任地交过了选择权，适合在院子中种植的花材……脑海中响起了那首童谣声。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Patty trustingly handed over the choice to me. Flowers suitable for planting in the yard… that nursery rhyme echoed in my mind.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 挑选了适合的花材，将选择的结果告诉帕蒂女士吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I've selected the suitable flowers. Now let me tell Ms. Patty my choice.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 采风之旅告一段落，逛了这么久回去整理一下思绪吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The inspiration-gathering trip has come to an end. After wandering around for so long, let's go back and sort through my thoughts.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 趁着帕蒂梳理灵感的时候，在附近看看吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: While Patty is organizing her inspiration, let me take a look around the area.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 通往二楼的道路已经开启，去二楼看看吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The path to the second floor is now open. Let's go check it out.

Description.SourceString: 提交<blue>正确道具</>推动回忆情节
Description.LocalizedString: Submit the <blue>correct items</> to advance the memory

PanelDescription.SourceString: 在错乱的时空里，需要找到推动情节的关键道具才能进行下去，而黑影的身份竟然是……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: In this chaotic timeline, you need to find the key items that drive the plot forward to proceed. And the identity of the dark shadow is actually…

PanelDescription.LocalizedString: In this chaotic timeline, you need to find the key items that drive the plot forward to proceed. And the identity of the dark shadow is actually…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 和过去的敌人战斗吧，战胜它们或许就能触摸到一切的答案。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Battle the enemies from your past. Defeating them might just let you find the answers you're seeking.

Description.SourceString: 将<blue>发卡</>交给帕蒂并与她交谈
Description.LocalizedString: Give the <blue>hair clip</> to Patty and talk to her

PanelDescription.SourceString: 被驱逐出来的还有一枚烧毁的发卡，拿着去问问帕蒂女士吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: A burnt hair clip was also expelled. Take it and ask Ms. Patty about it.

Description.LocalizedString: Go to the <blue>storage room</> on the second floor

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 离别是那样的痛苦，就算是到了现在，我都抗拒去想起那段时间。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Saying goodbye was so painful, even until now, I resist thinking back to those times.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 只要看到和她相关的东西，甚至这个家里每一处地方，我都能想象出她的样子，她的话语。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Just seeing anything related to her, even every corner of this house, I can picture her face and hear her voice.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 因为痛苦而烧毁一切的帕蒂并没有得到解脱，被烟尘覆盖的杂物间内，帕蒂终于找到了倾泻的机会。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Patty burned everything in her pain, yet found no relief. In the dust-covered storage room, Patty finally found a chance to let it all out…

Description.LocalizedString: Talk to the <blue>girl in the storage room</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 女孩出现了，这次她看起来很平静。或许她知道这封信的意义。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The girl appeared, and this time she looked very calm. Perhaps she knows the meaning of this letter.

Description.SourceString: 将<blue>信件</>交给帕蒂并与她交谈
Description.LocalizedString: Give the <blue>letter</> to Patty and talk to her

PanelDescription.SourceString: 过去的女孩拒绝了信件，这一次不会再见了。去将这封信交给真正需要它的人吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The girl from the past refused the letter, and it seems you won't cross paths again. Go give this letter to someone who truly needs it.

Description.SourceString: 返回展厅内并与<blue>钨丝先生</>交谈
Description.LocalizedString: Return to the exhibition hall and talk to <blue>Tungsten</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 帕蒂的故事就这样结束了，回展厅去吧，钨丝先生还在等着。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Patty's story has come to an end. Head back to the exhibition hall, Tungsten is still waiting.

Description.SourceString: 前往<blue>9℃咖啡厅</>门口与<blue>哈索尔</>会合
Description.LocalizedString: Head to the entrance of <blue>9°C Coffee</> and meet up with <blue>Hathor</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 哈索尔有事想要拜托你，去9℃咖啡厅门口找她吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Hathor has something she wants to ask of you. Go find her at the entrance of 9°C Coffee.

Description.SourceString: 前往<blue>改车店</>与<blue>哈索尔</>会合
Description.LocalizedString: Head to the <blue>mod shop</> and meet up with <blue>Hathor</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 哈索尔想借用一下你的小踏板，去愿木坡附近的改车店找她吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Hathor wants to borrow your scooter. Go find her at the mod shop near Yuanmu Hill.

Description.SourceString: 等<blue>哈索尔</>在<blue>半小时</>后回来
Description.LocalizedString: Wait for <blue>Hathor</> to return in <blue>half an hour</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 哈索尔正在测试小踏板的派送效率，大约需要半小时……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Hathor is testing the scooter's delivery efficiency. It'll take about half an hour…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 哈索尔完成了测试，问问她结果如何吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Hathor finished the test. Ask her how it went.

Description.LocalizedString: Go to <blue>Floe Cinema</> for your appointment

PanelDescription.SourceString: 哈索尔邀请你一起看电影，去浮冰影院赴约吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Hathor invited you to watch a movie together. Go to Floe Cinema for your date.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 距离电影开场还有段时间，不如先买点零食？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: We still have some time before the movie starts. How about we get some snacks first?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 看电影当然要配爆米花！
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Of course you need popcorn when watching a movie!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 准备完毕，和哈索尔一起进入放映厅吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: All set! Let's head into the screening room with Hathor.

QuestName.LocalizedString: Waiting for the Show To Start…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 和哈索尔一起入座……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Sitting down together with Hathor…

Description.SourceString: 在<blue>摩天轮</>下与<blue>哈索尔</>对话

PanelDescription.SourceString: 哈索尔似乎有新的想法……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Hathor seems to have a new idea…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 不过，现在这个位置似乎不太好……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Hmm, this angle doesn't seem quite right…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 想把摩天轮拍进去，需要寻找合适的位置和角度……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I want to get the ferris wheel in the shot, so I need to find the right position and angle…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 这里也没法拍到摩天轮……再换个位置看看？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: I can't get a good shot of the Ferris wheel from here either… Let's try another spot?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 想把摩天轮拍进去，需要寻找合适的位置和角度……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I want to get the ferris wheel in the shot, so I need to find the right position and angle…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 角度还差一点，还要再往上边去……爬上去试试？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: The angle's still off, I need to go higher… Let's go higher?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 想把摩天轮拍进去，需要寻找合适的位置和角度……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I want to get the ferris wheel in the shot, so I need to find the right position and angle…

PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I want to get the ferris wheel in the shot, so I need to find the right position and angle…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 合照完成了，和哈索尔聊聊吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The photo is captured. Chat with Hathor for a bit.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （不知道娜娜莉现在怎么样了……）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (I wonder how Nanally is…)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 这天傍晚，伊波恩很安静，你打算去看看娜娜莉。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: That evening, Eibon was unusually quiet—you decide to check on Nanally.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 这天傍晚，伊波恩很安静，你打算去看看娜娜莉。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: That evening, Eibon was unusually quiet—you decide to check on Nanally.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 阿德勒端着餐盘从宿舍走出，盘子里的食物分毫未动。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Adler came out of the dorm carrying a tray, the food on it completely untouched.

Description.LocalizedString: Check up on <blue>Nanally</> in the dormitory

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （阿德勒先生看起来，比平时话更少了……）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Adler is even more quiet than usual…)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 这会娜娜莉正在房间里，早雾也在，去看看她们吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Nanally is in the room with Sakiri. Go check on them.

Description.LocalizedString: Read the note left by someone

PanelDescription.SourceString: 沙发上多了一张纸条？是谁留下的？打开看看吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: A note on the sofa? Who left it there? Let's open it and see.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 是店长的字。她这是要出去办事么？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: It's Hotori's handwriting. Is she out on an errand?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 没听说。那是大叔留下的纸条，上面写了啥？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: I dunno. What's on that note from the old man?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 嗯……几句嘱咐吧。有叫你好好吃东西呢，早雾。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Hmm… just a few reminders, like telling you to eat well.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （店长她那么担心娜娜莉，也很防备「红字」，这种时候会轻易外出吗？）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (The Shopkeeper is worried about Nanally and wary of the Scarlet Letter. Would she go out at a time like this without a good reason?)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （还想问问阿德勒先生来着，怎么他也不见人影呢。）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Adler probably knows more about this, but he's nowhere to be seen.)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （只能去附近看看了，说不定阿德勒先生也在找店长。）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (I'll have to look around. Maybe Adler is looking for the Shopkeeper too.)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （这里就是你的狩猎场么，T女士。）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Madam T, this is the hunting grounds you mentioned?)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （让我想起小时候的试炼。你把我们丢在荒山里，命令大家在日落前回家。）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (It reminds me of the tests you put me through when I was little. You threw us deep in the mountains and told us to get home before the sun set.)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （你给一些孩子准备了登山靴，而另一些孩子仍穿着芭蕾舞鞋。）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (You gave some children hiking shoes, while others wore ballet shoes.)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （在山里面，穿着舞鞋和赤脚也没什么分别。岩石摸起来明明是冰凉的，但脚底却是火燎般地痛着。）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (But deep in the mountains, wearing ballet shoes is as good as wearing nothing. The rocky walls were cold to touch, but our feet were burning with pain.)

BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (This one was from a previous game. His Lumen Circle is still here, which means that he wasn't taken out by another participant.)

BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (The scholar considered himself outstanding when in fact he was just buttered up and manipulated by Madam T.)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （小时候的我，又何尝不是如此……）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Exactly like how I was when I was little…)

BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Butterflies? But these aren't real.)

BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Is this a trap, or just someone who doesn't care being tracked down…?)

BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (These two kids are the ones stuffed in the sacks… mere "consumables" sponsored by Madam T's guests.)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （如果不是拥有异能，她们也不会被抓进来吧。）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (They wouldn't have been captured in the first place if they weren't Espers.)

BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (I don't have any time to waste. I must… find you ASAP.)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 小心点，可能会有敌人。

PanelDescription.LocalizedString: These shadows… are they the shadows within?
