BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Chaos?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: ……你还在吗？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Are you there…?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 卡厄斯？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Chaos?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 该死！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Argh!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 怎么了？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: What's wrong?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 你知道我们在雾里走了多久吗？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Do you know how long we've been stuck in this fog?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 应该，也就一会儿吧。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Well, it's been a while.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 我看到有人跑了过去……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: I just saw someone run across…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 他们会把船舵带到哪里？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Where would they bring the helm?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 你看到的身影，难道不是我？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Are you sure that wasn't me?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 你太磨蹭了，我走两步就要等你半天。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: You're dragging the pace. I have to wait for you.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 还是说……她还在帮她那位「母亲」狩猎？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Or is she… still helping that "mother" on a hunt?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （都到这种时候了，他还是信不过我？）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (At a time like this, he still doesn't trust me?)
(That's not it…)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 卡厄斯，你的猎犬呢？难道它也会受到雾的影响……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Chaos, where's that hound of yours? Did the fog affect it too?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 那……汪汪？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Umm… Woof, woof?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （果然是她……）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (It has to be her…)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 这些影子……是我内心的幽影么？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: These shadows… are they the shadows within?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 这里怎么会有蝴蝶？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: How's a butterfly here?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 别担心，我把她们移去了安全的角落。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Don't worry. I moved them to a safe corner.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 讨厌的感觉……她们还好么？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I've got a bad feeling… Are they alright?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: ……好冷。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: So cold…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 伊艾尔在我的怀里……像块冰。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: I'm holding Irael… like holding ice.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 你们在哪？我看不见你们……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Where are you? I can't see you…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 我想松手了……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: I want to let go…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 讨厌的感觉……她们还好么？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I've got a bad feeling… Are they alright?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 果然是她……这次不会让你逃掉了，残虹。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: So it was her after all… I won't let you escape this time, Zankou.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 忘掉那些无趣的旁人，
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Forget the dull crowd fading from sight.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （不，残虹。你所在意的，已经不合时宜了。）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (No, Zankou. You're so out of touch.)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 忘掉那些冗余的挂碍。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Forget every burden clinging tight.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （正因为有他们在，我才能走到这里。）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (I made it this far only because of them.)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 忘掉你是你，
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Forget that you are you.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 我是我，
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: And I am me, too.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （那些亲昵的旧称谓，早已积了好厚一层灰。）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Those old nicknames, haven't used them in a long time.)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 就把今天，当作与我共度的末日……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Let today be our end of the world, just us two.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （我最后能为你做的，是回应此刻你的请求——）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (All I can do for you is to answer your request at this moment…)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 战斗（战斗）。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Battle (Battle)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 直至消融（至死方休）。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Till we melt away. (Till death holds sway.)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 原来你想对我说的是这些话……当初的我太过弱小，别说你，连我自己也保护不了。今天，就让我最后一次对你负责吧，残虹，或者说，妹妹。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: So that's what you were trying to tell me… Back then, I was too weak. I couldn't protect you—I couldn't even protect myself. Today, let me take responsibility for you one last time, Zankou… or rather, "little sister".

PanelDescription.SourceString: 原来你想对我说的是这些话……当初的我太过弱小，别说你，连我自己也保护不了。今天，就让我最后一次对你负责吧，残虹，或者说，妹妹。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: So that's what you were trying to tell me… Back then, I was too weak. I couldn't protect you—I couldn't even protect myself. Today, let me take responsibility for you one last time, Zankou… or rather, "little sister".

PanelDescription.SourceString: 你的颜色……该由我来定义吗，残虹……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Your color… am I the one who should define it, Zankou…?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 船舵就在眼前，可以松一口气了。问问看卡厄斯更多信息吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The Helm is right ahead. You can relax, just a bit. Ask Chaos for more info.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 妮夏原来知道这么多……我漏掉的信息实在太多了。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Turns out Nitsa knew a lot more than I had initially thought… It seems I missed a lot of clues.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 喂！破坏公共设施，记大过处分！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Hey! You're destroying public property! Your review isn't going to look great!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 嘿嘿，我好像超大号的心猎铁骑。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Heheh, I look like a gigantic Kokoro Rider.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 你像反派大怪兽还差不多~
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: You're more like a kaiju baddie!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 破……破坏的话不用赔钱吧？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: If we break it… we won't have to pay for it, right?

Description.LocalizedString: Track down the source of noise

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 咦，大白天的闹鬼了？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Huh? Ghosts appearing in the middle of the day?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 那是T女士的广告？之前在公寓楼里看到过。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: That's one of Madam T's ads? I saw that in an apartment.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 前面好吵……去看看吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Noise is coming from up ahead… let's go take a look.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 原来是歧骸……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: So they're oddities…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 就是它们害我听不清……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: They're the ones messing with my hearing…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 这些歧骸是被T女士的广告吸引来的？它们的声音好吵，干扰到……那个电波了。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Were these Oddities drawn in by Madam T's advertisement? They're so loud; they're interfering with that frequency…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 破……破坏的话不用赔钱吧？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: If we break it… we won't have to pay for it, right?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 这些歧骸是被T女士的广告吸引来的？它们的声音好吵，干扰到……那个电波了。

PanelDescription.SourceString: 破……破坏的话不用赔钱吧？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: If we break it… we won't have to pay for it, right?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 这些歧骸是被T女士的广告吸引来的？它们的声音好吵，干扰到……那个电波了。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Were these Oddities drawn in by Madam T's advertisement? They're so loud; they're interfering with that frequency…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 破……破坏的话不用赔钱吧？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: If we break it… we won't have to pay for it, right?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 这个歧骸看起来很强，应该是最大的噪音源了。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: That Oddity looks strong. It's most likely the biggest source of the disturbance.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 呼……世界安静了。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Phew… the noise finally went away.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 这是……「恒今时」？我在档案里看到过。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: That's… the Eternal Present? I read about it in the files.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 电波小鬼的电波真好用！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: The signal scamp got it right!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 前面的大楼……看到了恒今时的广告。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The building up ahead… I can see an Eternal Present billboard advertisement.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 要去救人。和妮夏、小贞一起，营救行动一定会成功的。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: We have to save them. With Nitsa and Xiaozhen together, this rescue mission is sure to succeed.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （唔……又是那个噪音。）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Ugh… that noise again.)

PanelDescription.SourceString: 妮夏？你看不到我么……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Nitsa? Can you see me…?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 我发现好像只要你跟我说话，那些刺耳的声音就会消失。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: I just realized that when you speak to me, those painful noises go away.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 那……建议我们持续进行聊天行为。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Then we should… continue to engage in the act of talking.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 好啊！呃，对了……你是谁来着……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Sure! But… umm, who are you again…?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 哎？我……我是……唔……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Me? I-I'm… umm…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 跟我牵着手的女孩是谁？唔……头好痛。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Who's the girl holding my hand? Ugh… my head hurts.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （聊什么话题呢……奇怪，什么都想不起来……）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (What can I talk about…? Weird, I can't remember anything…)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 嗯……有什么靠说话玩的游戏吗？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Is there… some game we can play by just talking?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 有许多种类。比如——辩论游戏？我们各持不同的观点，互相质询。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: There are a few. Maybe… a debating game? We can hold contrasting views and question each other.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 像这样一起走的话，聊点什么好呢……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: What should we talk about while we're walking…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: ……治、治什么？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: How's that… a game?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 呃……或者——成语接龙？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Umm… how about… the word chain game?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 这个我会！我来起个头？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: I know this! Can I start?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 好。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Sure.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 嗯……我先来个「一命通关」。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Hmm… I'll start with "speedrun."

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 一命通关是成语么？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Speedrun? Is that a popular genre on Bagel?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 不重要啦，只要是4个字的就算数吧？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: The word just popped out of my head. It's still a start, right?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 聊点什么……或者一起玩游戏？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Wanna chat about something… or maybe play a game together?

Description.LocalizedString: Hand in hand, let's play a game

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 呃，那——「关门大吉」。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Alright then, I'll follow up with "negotiate."

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 吉——吉——「极限反杀」？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: E… "Epic"!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 「杀气冲天」。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: "Compound."

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 「天牛流星拳」。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: "DPS."

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: ……「全力以赴」。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: …"Social."

PanelDescription.SourceString: 一起玩成语接龙吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Let's play a round of word chain!

Description.LocalizedString: Hand in hand, let's play a game

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 「付费道具」？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: "Lagging"?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 「聚沙成塔」。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: "Gestalt."

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 獭……麻吉？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: "T… Tamachi"?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 「獭麻吉」是什么？而且这次只有3个字呀。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Tamachi? Did you just make up that word?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 獭麻吉是电子宠物，很可爱的！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: No way! Tamachis are cute electronic pets!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 好吧。那就，「急转直下」。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Fine. I'll follow up with "ironic."

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 「下班回家」！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: "Cartridge"!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 「家喻户晓」。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: "Equinox."
Xiao… zhen…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 一起玩成语接龙吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Let's play a round of word chain!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 前面的路灯下，有个小男孩？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Is there a little boy under the streetlight ahead?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 一定要……这样你死我活的较量吗？辉环收集齐了，接下来该去哪里？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Must we really… kill each other? We've collected all the Lumen Circles. Where do we go now?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 前面……是伊波恩的大门？怎么会出现在这里？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Up ahead… is that the Gate of Eibon? How?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 这是……伊波恩？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: This is… Eibon?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 大厅……怎么少了好多东西？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: The hall… Why are so many things missing?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 调查这个伊波恩。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Investigate Eibon.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 桌上的报纸是最新的么？看看上面写了什么。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Is that the latest edition of the newspaper? Check what it says.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 等等，三个月前？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Wait, three months ago?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 这里是……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: This is…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 未来的，伊波恩？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Eibon from the future?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 调查这个伊波恩。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Investigate Eibon.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 二楼有些吵闹，去看看。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: There seems to be a commotion happening on the second floor. Go check it out.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 要不然，塔吉多还是留下吧。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Well, I think Taygedo should stay.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 店里已经没有需要修理的东西了。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: There's nothing to fix in the shop anymore.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 早雾、埃德嘉、塔吉多……你们在说什么呀……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Sakiri, Edgar, Taygedo… what are you all talking about…?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （埃德嘉……）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Edgar…)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: （如果这间屋子坏掉了，塔吉多可以修好它。）
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: (Even if this house falls apart, Taygedo can still fix it.)

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 可是，屋子里的人不在了，修好了也只是一个空空的伊波恩呢。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: But fixing the house wouldn't fix the fact that people are missing from their rooms at Eibon.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 塔吉多照顾好娜娜莉，我和呆子去把他们找回来。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Taygedo, take care of Nanally. I'll go with dummy to bring them back.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 早雾、埃德嘉、塔吉多……你们在说什么呀……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Sakiri, Edgar, Taygedo… what are you all talking about…?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 塔吉多，你在想什么？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Taygedo, what's on your mind?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 早雾，你在想什么？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Sakiri, what's on your mind?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 埃德嘉，你在想什么？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Edgar, what are you thinking?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 这不是我想要的伊波恩，我要离开。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: This isn't the Eibon I want. I'm leaving.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 去前面的伊波恩看看。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Go investigate the "Eibon" up ahead.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 我好像在……接委托？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I think I'm… accepting a commission?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 是「忧郁的美男子」……店里好多东西看起来都卖掉了，但是它还在……嗯……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: It's the "Melancholic Dandy"… A lot of stuff in the shop looks like it's been sold off, but it's still here… Hmm…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 哀南姆镜竟然还在？看看去。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The Mirror of Anam is still here? Let's check it out.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 这个未来的「我」……在说些什么可怕的话啊……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: This future "me"… what horrible things are they saying…?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 解决掉这些歧骸。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Eliminate the Oddities.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 这不是我想要的伊波恩，我要离开。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: This isn't the Eibon I want. I'm leaving.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 去前面的伊波恩看看。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Go investigate the "Eibon" up ahead.

BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Huh…?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: ……像这样快速回击？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Do a fast counter like this…?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 你回来了。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: You're back.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 鉴定师！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Appraiser!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 娜娜莉……你醒了……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Nanally… you're awake…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 又多了一个差评，让我看看怎么说的？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Another bad review? Lemme see what this loser has to say.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 「……店员矮个小孩性情恶劣……」咦，呆子也有被挑刺的时候？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: "…the short kiddo employee has no manners…" Why would anyone find fault with the dummy?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 早雾和埃德嘉，像往常一样拌嘴呢。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Sakiri and Edgar are at it again, as per usual.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: ……上个月做了好几单大生意，账面上怎么还是冒出赤字来了？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: …We did a few big commissions last month, how are we still losing money?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 小姐，您忘了刚刚结掉斯特利那边的赊账。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Lady, you haven't settled the tab from Sterry.
Tch…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 还得靠招财宝，多招揽几笔买卖，把钱狠狠赚回来。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Precious, I'll need you to get us more cases and make our money back.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 对了，招财宝……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: By the way, Precious…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 店长啊店长，也是一如既往地……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Boss, just like always…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 店长要跟我说什么？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: What does the Boss want to tell me?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 离开这个「良夜」。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Escape this "Good Night."

PanelDescription.SourceString: 去前面的伊波恩看看。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Go investigate the "Eibon" up ahead.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 那是店长……未来的店长？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Is that… the Boss? Boss from the future?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 那是店长……未来的店长？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Is that… the Boss? Boss from the future?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 那是店长……未来的店长？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Is that… the Boss? Boss from the future?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 触碰第一枝，前往……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Touch The First Branch, then go to…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 终于见到T女士了，还有——店长！还有……阿德勒，灵可和妮夏，达芙蒂尔，卡厄斯……大家都来了。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: We finally found Madam T… and—Boss! And… Adler, Linko, Nitsa, Daffodill, Chaos… everyone is here.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 一切的真相都已揭晓。必须击败T女士。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The truth has been revealed. You must defeat Madam T.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 一切的真相都已揭晓。必须击败T女士。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The truth has been revealed. You must defeat Madam T.

PanelDescription.SourceString: T女士的贪婪，似乎吸引来了……更强大的家伙。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Madam T's greed seems to have attracted… something even stronger.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 一切的真相都已揭晓。必须击败T女士。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The truth has been revealed. You must defeat Madam T.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 银河倒悬，宇宙无声；群星岿然，只是闪耀。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The Milky Way hangs inverted across a silent cosmos; still, the stars stand resolute and shine on.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 大家……都在我的房间，有很多话想倾诉的样子。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Everyone… they're all in my room, and it looks like they all have something to say.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 没想到小男子汉埃德嘉也会掉眼泪……我知道你有很努力在帮忙，埃德嘉。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: I didn't expect even Edgar to begin tearing up… I know you were really trying hard to help, Edgar.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 店长脸上的哀伤转瞬即逝，又恢复了平时的模样：最不靠谱，同时也是最靠谱的伊波恩店长。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The sadness on the Boss's face vanished in an instant, and she reverted back to her usual self: Eibon's least reliable—yet somehow most reliable—Boss.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 是我的错觉吗？感觉达芙蒂尔比平时爱笑了一点。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Is it just me, or is Daffodill smiling a little more than usual?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 娜娜莉……你的灵魂，百分之百完全回归了吧？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Nanally… your soul's returned completely, right?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 懂不懂先来后到！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: I got first dibs!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 停下！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Stop already!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 略略略……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Nyah nyah nyah!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 你给我等着！！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: I'll catch you!

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 你~追~不~着~
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Can't—touch—this!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 星盘应该在大厅里吧？莳小姐在这里待得惯吗？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The Astral Chart should be in the lobby, right? Is Ms. Thyme comfortable here?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 局长找我，应该是想问问零号异象的事吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The BAC Director's calling me in… it's probably about Code Zero.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 黑羽传来了邀约。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Blackbird has sent an invitation.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 目的地——噗卡乐园
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Destination — Pukaland

PanelDescription.SourceString: 黑羽会在哪里呢。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Where could Blackbird be?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 黑羽会在哪里呢。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Where could Blackbird be?

Description.SourceString: 向<blue>黑羽</>了解<blue>「异世界」</>都市传说
Description.LocalizedString: Learn about the <blue>Other World</> urban legend from <blue>Blackbird</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 据黑羽所说，传说大部分都与梦游茶话会、花篱秘密园、噗卡奇迹之轮有关。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: According to Blackbird, most of the legendary tales are tied to the Dreamland Tea Party, the Flora Maze, and the Puka Wonder Wheel.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 去第一个传说地点看看吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Check out the first location from the urban legend.

Description.SourceString: 依照传说所说给<blue>黑羽</>拍照
Description.LocalizedString: Take a photo of <blue>Blackbird</> as described in the urban legend

PanelDescription.SourceString: 就像传说里说的那样，在黑羽招手时拍下照片。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: As per the urban legend, take a photo when Blackbird waves.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 照片中会有异常情况……吗？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Could there be something unusual in the photo…?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 梦游茶话会调查无果。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The investigation into the Dreamland Tea Party turned up nothing.

Description.SourceString: 好像有个<blue>游客</>在朝这边招手……
Description.LocalizedString: Looks like a <blue>tourist</> is waving over here…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 似乎是想来验证相关传说的游客？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Looks like a tourist is also here to see if the legend's true?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 黑羽擅长走迷宫吗？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Blackbird, are you good at finding your way through mazes?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 只玩过一些迷宫游戏呢。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: I've only gone through a few maze games before.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 不过，为了调查的话，还是不擅长走迷宫比较好吧。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Still, if we're investigating, it'd probably be better not to be too good at mazes, right?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 毕竟我们是要努力迷路的人！
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: After all, we're supposed to be trying our hardest to get lost!

PanelDescription.SourceString: 去第二个传说地点看看吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Check out the second location from the urban legend.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 尝试验证传说，第四次经过同一个路口会遇到什么呢？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Put the legend to the test: what happens when you pass the same maze intersection for a fourth time?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 这里的灌木花丛好像会随机移动，要想经过同一个路口四次，还是得多留心才行。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: The hedges and flowerbeds here seem to shift around at random, so we'll have to pay close attention if we want to pass through the same maze intersection four times.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 不知道占卜往哪走会不会有结果……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: I wonder if divination could tell us which way to go…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 黑羽不妨占卜一下试试呢？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Blackbird, why not try divining it?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 好像……无法预测呢。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: It seems like I can't predict where it'd appear…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 没事的，不论如何都是命运的安排。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: It's fine. Either way, it's all part of fate's grand plan.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 呵呵，现在鉴定师也会说这样的话了……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Hehe, so now you're starting to talk like that too…

PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Put the legend to the test: what happens when you pass the same maze intersection for a fourth time?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 等等，那边好像有什么声音？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Hold on, I think I hear something over there.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 难道说……真有什么异常吗？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Could it be… there really is some kind of anomaly?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 鉴定师有听到吗？
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Appraiser, did you hear that?

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 好像是花丛里？去看看吧。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Sounds like it's coming from the flower bushes. Let's go check.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 尝试验证传说，第四次经过同一个路口会遇到什么呢？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Put the legend to the test: what happens when you pass the same maze intersection for a fourth time?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 嗯……难道异常情况出现了？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Hmm… Could an anomaly have appeared?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 异常情况没有出现。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: No abnormality was detected.

Description.SourceString: 查看再度发出异响的<blue>草丛</>
Description.LocalizedString: Check the <blue>bush</> that just made another strange noise

PanelDescription.SourceString: 嗯……难道异常情况又出现了？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Hmm… Did something unusual happen again?

PanelDescription.SourceString: 去第三个传说地点看看吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Check out the third location from the urban legend.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 要乘坐十三圈呢……这是休息还是调查？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: We have to go around thirteen times… Is this supposed to be a vacation or an investigation?

QuestName.LocalizedString: Thirteen Turns of the Wonder Wheel

PanelDescription.SourceString: 好像并未发现任何异常情况。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: It seems no anomalies were found.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 噗卡奇迹之轮调查无果。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The investigation of the Puka Wonder Wheel yielded no results.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 到站了呢。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: We've arrived.

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 好像并没有出现「异世界」的入口……
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: Looks like the entrance to the "Other World" has yet to show up…

BeginIntroduceArray.SourceString: 其它异常也没有。
BeginIntroduceArray.LocalizedString: No other anomalies, either.

PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The investigation of the Puka Wonder Wheel yielded no results.

Description.SourceString: 那边有两位行事鬼祟的<blue>游客</>……
Description.LocalizedString: There are two sneaky <blue>tourists</> over there…

PanelDescription.SourceString: 他们好像拍到了什么？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: It seems like they captured something?

Description.LocalizedString: The investigation is over for now

PanelDescription.SourceString: 看来都市传说……终究只是传说。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Looks like the urban legend… was just a legend after all.

Description.SourceString: 又遇到一位<blue>游客</>……幸运儿？

PanelDescription.SourceString: 祝愿奇迹与你同行。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: May many miracles be bestowed upon you.
